core_obligations: Identify the fibre X'_{y'} with the base change of X_y to Spec(kappa(y')).
Apply the after-field-extension criterion for geometric connectedness.
Conclude the two subsets of Y' agree.

proof_roadmap.step: Rewrite fibres of the base change as field extensions of original fibres.

difficulty_reason: For any morphism f : X -> Y and any base change g : Y' -> Y with projection f' : X' -> Y', the subset of Y' where the fibres of f' are geometrically connected equals the inverse image under g of the corresponding subset of Y. The retained proof is written out: it reduces to the assertion that X'_{y'} = X_y x_y y' is geometrically connected over kappa(y') iff X_y is geometrically connected over kappa(y), concluding by the Varieties lemma that geometric connectedness is checked after arbitrary field extension. Retained author proof at lines 7895-7902.
